full_prompt_en: A square graphic painting shows a line of small dark laboring figures scattered across sloped ground beneath a dense canopy of stylized trees. Several figures lean over long-handled tools, while others stand or bend in silhouette. One taller worker near the center raises an arm over a tool shaft, giving the line its strongest gesture. Thin vertical trunks repeat throughout the scene and connect to broad fan-shaped crowns made of overlapping teal, olive and gray-green circles. Behind them, large orange and pale gold discs overlap in the sky like a setting sun seen through layers of foliage. The central opening glows warm orange, while dark blue-green curves and angular planes fill the foreground. The figures remain almost entirely flat and dark, without individual faces. Their actions register through posture, spacing and the diagonals of their tools. Each tree crown is built from small translucent arcs and semicircles, so the woodland feels like an ordered mosaic rather than a naturalistic forest. Narrow vertical shafts keep the composition upright even as the ground rolls in broad waves below. Light comes from behind the workers, reducing them to silhouettes and making the orange opening the main source of brightness. The palette limits itself to smoky teal, brown, charcoal, ochre and warm apricot. A worn printed texture softens the geometric edges and adds subtle grain throughout. The image feels both rhythmic and solemn, combining repeated laboring bodies with a monumental pattern of trunks, circular foliage and low sun.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形绘画呈现一列细小深色劳动者散布在倾斜地面上，头顶是密集的程式化树冠。几个人俯身操作长柄工具，另一些站着或弯成剪影。中央附近一名较高的劳动者抬起手臂，握着工具柄，形成整列最强的动作。细竖树干在场景中反复出现，连到由重叠青绿、橄榄色和灰绿圆形组成的宽扇形树冠。其后，大块橙色与浅金色圆盘在天空叠合，像落日透过层层树叶。中央缺口发着暖橙光，深蓝绿色弧面和棱角平面填满前景。人物几乎完全平涂为深色，没有个体面孔。动作由姿态、间距和工具斜线表现。每个树冠都由半透明小弧与半圆搭成，因此林地像有序马赛克，而非写实树林。狭窄竖向树干保持构图直立，下方地面却以宽阔波形起伏。光从劳动者后面来到，将他们压成剪影，使橙色缺口成为主要明亮来源。调色限制在烟灰青绿、褐、炭黑、赭与暖杏色。磨旧印刷肌理柔化几何边缘，在全画铺上细颗粒。图像既有节奏又庄严，把反复劳动的身体与树干、圆形树冠和低日构成的巨大纹样合在一起。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte graphic painting surface with overlapping translucent discs, flat dark silhouettes and a lightly worn print texture. Smoky teal and blue-green occupy most of the field, while orange and pale gold glow through layered openings. Repeated narrow verticals support broad circular and fan-shaped masses, creating a measured pattern across the frame. Low diagonal marks and rolling dark planes add movement near the bottom. Edges are generally geometric yet softened by grain and transparency where colored layers intersect. Backlight converts smaller near forms into compact silhouettes and lets gesture be read through outline alone. Space is shallow and stage-like, with depth suggested by overlapping circles, repeated trunks and graduated warm color. Brightness concentrates behind the middle zone rather than washing every surface. The composition feels monumental despite its small repeated marks, joining a steady collective rhythm to a dense, atmospheric mosaic of cool and warm shapes.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光图形绘画表面，重叠半透明圆片、平涂深色剪影和轻微磨旧的版画肌理共存。烟灰青绿与蓝绿占据大部分色域，橙色和浅金色从叠层缺口中发光。重复的细竖线托住宽阔圆形和扇形团块，在画幅内建立有度纹样。低处斜线和起伏的深色平面增加运动。边缘大体几何化，却在颗粒与有色层交叉的透明处变软。逆光把较小的近处形体化成紧凑剪影，仅凭轮廓即可读出动作。空间较浅、近似舞台，纵深由圆形重叠、竖线重复和渐变暖色暗示。亮度集中在中间区域背后，没有冲洗所有表面。构图尽管由微小重复笔痕组成，仍显宏大，把稳定的集体节奏接到冷暖形状构成的密集空气马赛克上。
theme_en: Dark workers labor with long tools among stylized trees under an orange sky of overlapping circular forms
theme_zh: 深色劳动者手持长工具在程式化树木间劳作，橙色天空由重叠圆形构成
name: Aaron Douglas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
